confidence_notes: Food anchors use a [July 2026 Numbeo snapshot](https://cityhonestly.com/koh-samui/cost-of-living) based on 38 contributors over 18 months. Cocktails reflect [local bar ranges](https://kohsamuitrips.com/koh-samui-nightlife/); wine is estimated at roughly 2.7 times draft beer. Drink prices vary by venue. July accommodation prices are general-knowledge estimates and are less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates draw on Thai resort islands, especially Phuket, with an allowance for Koh Samui's island costs and July tourism demand.
